verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone platform with AI features: call transcription and summaries, AI call tags, the Sona AI agent, and MCP/LLM connectors. Whether customer data is used for model training is therefore a fair privacy question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or any AI-training privacy control, so there is no support for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
